text: A Song of the Ascents. 1 Blessed [is] everyone who fears YHWH, those walking in His ways!
The labor of your hands, surely you shall eat; blessings and good [are] unto you.
Your wife [is] fruitful like a vine in the sides of your house, your sons like shoots of olive trees round about your table.
Behold, how thus is blessed the man fearing YHWH.
May YHWH bless you from Zion, that you may look on the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
and may you see the sons of your sons! Peace [be] upon Israel!
